about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #838 at build 12a7825. The previous take bound 15e5d3f; main has since merged #831 (12a7825), which moves js/40_render.js - one of the four blobs that draw a frame - so recap labelled those frames FRAME-STALE and the front page again described a picture that does not ship. This pass is the same eight poses re-run against the deploy, which serves main’s bytes: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by that URL sha256-match this checkout, twelve for twelve, proved before the shutter. Route: tools/livecap.js devRoute - one page load and one boot per pose at ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.set("grain",0), DEV.clear() before the pose, shutter from the canvas after DEV.tick; window pinned (CAP_WIN=1440,906) so the canvas decodes 1440x763. Chromium gave RGBA, committed through tools/png_rgb.js. Every seat, layout and luma below was read back out of the page that drew the frame, and every mean re-measured from these bytes with tools/recap.js’s own decoder, not the capture harness’s. Pose: the spawn seat, then DEV.clear() and DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6); the route’s own seat search turned the bearing 1.44 m and left him at (13.50, 12.63), 6.00 m out, 0.24 rad off the view line, on a floorAt 2.00 band with 587 raster px of him painted. The route’s DEV.clear() leaves the HUD reading 1 LEFT for this pose (1 enemy in the frame: the posed grunt). Layout signature 2826521082 for this sector under seed 60.Audio term: SND.ac.sampleRate read 48000 in the page that drew this frame, so this seed deals this layout on an instrument that draws 72,000 seeded values through SND.init’s noise buffer before the generator, where the rows these frames replace state 44100 and 66,150 (#404). All three layout signatures therefore differ from the replaced rows, on a build whose generator draw count also moved; the deal a URL names is per audio device, and this row states the device it was dealt on. The superseded frame is read from 800a6ff, the commit that put the bytes this pass replaces on main (those pixels were taken at build 15e5d3f).
